assessments.zone: Rural villages of Lusanga and Pay Kongila secteurs (Lusanga, Bulungu, Mosango and Kikwit health zones) between Bulungu and Kikwit
assessments.evidence: Area between Bulungu town and Kikwit, far from the Mobondo theatre in Kwamouth/western Bagata; no armed-group control reported. State authority through PNC posts and customary chiefs assumed. Web research was unavailable for this run (web search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the proxy), so this rests on default state presence and prior knowledge of the region.

assessments.zone: Main centres of the unit (pop. >10,000): Bivac and Kwenge (Kwenge health areas, Pay Kongila), Carrefour/Kwanga and Kakoy (Lusanga health zone), Cdr (Djuma mission centre)
assessments.evidence: Larger trading/mission centres in Bulungu territory (Kwilu) with PNC posts, secteur administration and customary chiefs; no armed group is reported to hold or regularly operate in these localities. The Mobondo militia's spillover into Kwilu has concerned western Bagata territory, not this eastern part of Bulungu. Web research was unavailable for this run (web search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the proxy), so this rests on default state presence and prior knowledge of the region.

assessments.zone: Rural villages of Djuma secteur (Djuma and Vanga health zones, plus a Bulungu-HZ locality), along the Kwilu/Inzia west of Bulungu
assessments.evidence: No reports of armed-group activity located for Djuma secteur villages; ordinary state authority via PNC posts, secteur administration and customary chiefs is assumed. Bagata territory to the west is the nearest Mobondo-affected area, but no incursions into Djuma secteur are known. Web research was unavailable for this run (web search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by the proxy), so this rests on default state presence and prior knowledge of the region. Djuma secteur is the part of the unit closest to Bagata territory, where Mobondo holdouts were still reported raiding in 2026, so sporadic incursions cannot be excluded.

assessments.zone: Vanga secteur villages toward the Bagata/Masi-Manimba borders (Vanga and Djuma health zones: Zaba, Mbelo, Belemiese, Miheta, Nganga, Kingala, Kilusu, Mupoy, etc.)
assessments.evidence: No source reports armed-group activity in this area as of the reference date; the Mobondo militia theatre (Kwamouth, Bagata, Kenge) lies to the west/south-west across the Kwilu/Kwango. Assessment rests on default state presence (PNC posts at secteur/groupement level, customary chiefs under state authority); live web research was unavailable for this run. This zone is the closest part of the unit to Bagata territory, where Mobondo holdouts were still reported raiding in 2026, so incursions cannot be excluded.

assessments.zone: Vanga Victoire (Vanga mission/hospital town, Vanga health zone seat) on the Kwilu
assessments.evidence: Mission and hospital town and secteur seat with PNC post; no armed-group activity reported. Mobondo violence affects territories to the west (Bagata, Kwamouth) but is not reported in Vanga. Web research was unavailable for this run.

assessments.zone: Bulungu secteur villages and towns around Bulungu town (Bulungu, Djuma and Lusanga health zones: Kintambu, Nkara, Ekubi, Longo, Niadi, Tebetebe, Mayala, etc.)
assessments.evidence: No source reports armed-group activity in this area as of the reference date; the Mobondo militia theatre (Kwamouth, Bagata, Kenge) lies to the west/south-west across the Kwilu/Kwango. Assessment rests on default state presence (PNC posts at secteur/groupement level, customary chiefs under state authority); live web research was unavailable for this run.

assessments.zone: Bulungu town, territorial seat on the Kwilu river (Bulungu health zone, CBCO Bulungu area)
assessments.evidence: Territorial seat with territorial administration, PNC commissariat and courts; no armed group reported controlling the town. The Mobondo militia is active further west (Kwamouth, Bagata) and not reported in Bulungu. Web research was unavailable for this run.

units.CD3204-bulungu-2: This unit covers the Djuma, Lusanga and Pay Kongila secteurs of Bulungu territory (Kwilu), a rural area between the Kwilu river and Kikwit covering the Lusanga, Djuma and Vanga health zones (plus fringes of Bulungu, Mosango and Kikwit health zones). No armed group is known to exercise territorial control here; the Mobondo militia that spread from Kwamouth into Kwilu since 2022 has affected mainly western Bagata territory. All localities are assessed as under ordinary state authority with the PNC as main permanent force, supported by territorial administration and customary chiefs. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, sources blocked), so confidence is low for rural villages. A skeptical review (2026-10-01) could not run independent web searches either (search budget exhausted, AllAfrica and search engines blocked), so the assessment remains unverified; neighbouring Bagata territory across the Kwilu still saw Mobondo holdout raids in 2026 per sibling-unit sources, so incursions into western Djuma secteur cannot be excluded.
units.CD3204-bulungu-1: Bulungu territory (Kwilu), part 1, covers Bulungu town and the Bulungu and Vanga areas along the Kwilu river (Bulungu, Vanga, Djuma and Lusanga health zones). No armed group is reported to control or regularly raid any locality here; the Mobondo militia theatre (Kwamouth, western Bagata, Kenge) lies to the west. All locations are assessed as under ordinary state authority with the PNC as the main permanent force and customary chiefs operating under it. Live web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, news sites blocked), so confidence is medium for the two main towns and low elsewhere.
